authorization.meaning: explicit authorization to expand C069 development sample after STATE89 required authorization before any new A package

purpose: Open exactly one deterministic new development package A03, then test whether the already-frozen matched-pair state-dynamics candidate can be legally evaluated without changing the estimand, calipers, coverage gates, model recipe, or formal boundary.

source_boundary.selection_order: ascending sha256(selection_seed + '|' + match_id) over the full source match universe
source_boundary.overlap_rule: A01/A02/A03 match-id overlap must equal zero
source_boundary.market_reason: A-series public match/event packages contain no PIT-qualified synchronized market quotes; no retrospective market input may be fabricated.

estimand.population: regular-duration selected A01+A02+A03 matches with both teams having >=4 prior selected union matches and final outcome either draw or one-goal win
estimand.target: P(draw | outcome in {draw, one-goal win}, matched prematch environment)
estimand.settlement: 90 minutes including stoppage; only 1H/2H events; non-regular-duration matches excluded

pit_contract.goal_event_rule: own-goal tag102 always score-changing; ordinary tag101 score-changing only for eventName in {Shot, Free Kick} to exclude goalkeeper Save-attempt duplication

folds.policy: reuse the exact R1 absolute chronological date boundaries; do not recompute cutpoints after A03 is opened

matching.objective: lexicographic maximum cardinality then minimum total normalized distance

state_features.draw_persistence: mean home/away prior smoothed P(FT draw | tied at 60/70/80)
state_features.equalizer_hazard: mean home/away prior smoothed equalizers per 90 minutes spent trailing by exactly one goal
state_features.rebreak_hazard: mean home/away prior smoothed tie-breaking goals per 90 minutes spent tied after an equalizer
state_features.late_tied_aggression: mean home/away prior smoothed shots per 90 tied minutes from minute 60 onward

evaluation_if_and_only_if_coverage_passe.primary_metric: binary log loss candidate minus baseline
development_signal_gate: at least 2 of 3 folds improve log_loss
candidate within-pair accuracy > baseline within-pair accuracy

stop_and_interpretation.coverage_failure: STOP_COVERAGE; no model fitting/scoring and no positive/negative feature verdict
stop_and_interpretation.coverage_pass_then_signal: development signal only; not scientific confirmation and formal_weight remains 0
stop_and_interpretation.coverage_pass_then_no_signal: development negative for this frozen representation; do not model-shop same information after viewing R3 labels
